meta.title: From pull request to production
meta.description: A change passes CI and one review, waits in the merge queue, then reaches production through a canary.

theme.concept: An editor's proof: warm paper, brown ink, one teal for what ships.

steps.caption: Every change starts as a pull request, and CI runs in about {{ci.median_minutes}}.
A red check sends the change back to its author before anyone reviews it.
Green changes get one review, then wait in the merge queue for tests on main.
The queue ships to production about {{ci.deploys_per_day}} a day.
A canary takes {{ci.canary_share}} of traffic first, so a bad change reaches few people.
